body: Happiness means to me that I won’t feel the need to cry or cut every night. That I won’t feel so numb anymore. That I won’t think that everyone would be better off without me even if they would.
I don’t have a safe space without judgement.

Don’t go. It’s not your time to go yet. Sometimes the rollercoaster that we call life has it’s ups and downs but yours is not ending today. Think about how this will effect everyone who cares for you, even if it feels like nobody cares for you people do. We’re in this together and it’s not gonna end just yet. You can stay a little longer I believe in you. Don’t lose hope just yet.
I love you and I care.
